title: wissadula luciana
intro: Wissadula luciana, commonly known as Luciana, is a plant species in the Malvaceae family, native to tropical regions. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. Its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and glycosides, contribute to its therapeutic actions, which may aid in wound healing, reducing pain and inflammation, and protecting against oxidative stress. The plant's extracts have been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including skin infections, fever, and respiratory issues.
